items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: And what did you call them? Because I was a twin, see, they called us Punch and Judah.

ctx.x: Bud. But the people outside called me Punch.
And what did you call them? Because I was a twin, see, they called us Punch and Judah.
Uh-huh. What did your niece call you? Uncle Bud? Or a little Lionel used to call you Uncle Bud. Yeah, yeah, yeah.
